race_estimator: prob_target_hit_22d = P(best high >= target) x P(worst low > -stop), class-weighted over the excursion pools (stage4.race_probability). The product of two positively-associated marginals is at most their joint, so it understates the first-touch race and is never tuned upward — a disclosed lower bound (decision D, 2026-10-16).

label_window.rule: the 22-session forward label window, including the row's own session, must lie inside a single committed vintage

feature_window.rule: the 200-session feature history, ending at the row's own session, must stay inside a single gapless run of the merged series (overlapping vintages chain; a hole no fetch covers ends a run)

cv.graded_event: the target-versus-stop race at the reference band: 1 iff the 22-session forward window prints +3.0% before -3.0% from the entry (first touch wins, one bar carrying both resolves to the stop — stage4.first_touch_outcome)
cv.brier_note: oof_brier_race is stage4.race_probability — the conservative product of the two excursion marginals — evaluated at the reference band off this fold's training pools through stage4.samples_for, against the row's own race label; oof_brier_race_base_rate is the constant-predictor floor at the corpus's own race-win share. The shipped payload's prob_target_hit_22d is the same estimator at each trade's own target and stop
cv.cone_definition: path envelope on the session extremes: p10/p25 from the adverse-excursion mixture (worst low), p50 from terminal returns, p75/p90 from the favourable-excursion mixture (best high) (stage4.CONE_SPEC)
cv.excursion_realization: session extremes (low/high) against the entry close
cv.coverage_note: oof_cone_coverage_pct grades the shipped envelope against the bar path (the realization the coverage gate reads), oof_cone_pooled_coverage_pct grades the pooled block's envelope over the same rows (the cost of the sector conditioning, published not tuned), oof_cone_close_path_coverage_pct against the close path of the same windows, and oof_cone_terminal_coverage_pct against the closing session alone
cv.purge_rule: per symbol, on its own session calendar: a training row is dropped when its forward label window would reach the fold's date span, or when it sits inside the embargo tail
cv.pool_conditioning: the trade's own sector's block when every class of every measure holds >= stage4.MIN_SECTOR_ATOMS_PER_CLASS atoms, else the pooled block (stage4.samples_for — the shipped selector)

hyperparameters.note: frozen constants, not selected on the CV folds

provenance.note: Sourced booster for BRD §5.2's target-versus-stop race engine (decision D — the graded event is the reference-band race, not the 1-month up/down): real yfinance daily bars for the symbols whose sectoral index the tier-1 source serves, point-in-time rows only with forward label windows kept inside one committed vintage and feature histories kept inside one gapless run of overlapping vintages, validated by purged group time-series CV (BRD §5.2). The trained universe is disclosed in corpus.symbols / corpus.symbols_excluded.
